overview_description.description: While they can’t do anything about your actual date, Kwaan is here to help things along by suggesting thoughtfully recommended venues depending on the stage of dating that you are in. Is it a first date? Are you in that lovely butterfly stage? Have things started getting serious, and you’ve started to hold hands?! Or, have you laid down the anchor and are you after a heavy hitting “star” date? These days it’s about putting in a little thought and showing that you have got the knowledge to seriously entertain and impress.
